parts.zh: 新罕布什尔州一名男子五十多年前投入海中的漂流瓶在1500英里外被发现
瓶中的纸条写道:"送回海洋街419号,可从Beachcomber汽车旅馆的业主Richard和Tina Pierce那里获得150美元的奖励。"
这家汽车旅馆在1960年由Paula Pierce的父母所有
W: 哦，不太想看。不太吸引我
M: 我想是关于气候变化如何影响日常生活的
W: 嗯，听起来真的很糟糕
M: 有一个西班牙舞蹈节
M: 据说非常精彩。我们看看报纸上怎么说
W: 好的，那什么时间演出？

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: The return of a bottled message to its owner's daughter.
choices.zh: 将一个瓶中信归还给其主人的女儿。

choices.text: A New Hampshire man's joke with friends on his wife.
choices.zh: 一位新罕布什尔州男子对妻子开的一个玩笑,涉及他的朋友们。

choices.text: A father's message for his daughter.
choices.zh: 一位父亲给女儿的留言。

choices.text: The history of a century-old motel.
choices.zh: 一家百年历史汽车旅馆的历史。

items.stem: Why did Paula Pierce give Clint Buffington the reward?

choices.text: She wanted to show gratitude for his kindness.
choices.zh: 她想对他的善意表示感谢。

choices.text: She wanted to honor her father's promise.
choices.zh: 她想兑现父亲的承诺。

choices.text: She had been asked by her father to do so.
choices.zh: 她父亲曾要求她这样做。

choices.text: She was excited to see her father's handwriting.
choices.zh: 她看到父亲的笔迹感到很激动。

items.stem: Why were spraying operations carried out in Dorchester County?

choices.text: People were concerned about the number of bees.
choices.zh: 人们担心蜜蜂的数量。

choices.text: Several cases of Zika disease had been identified.
choices.zh: 已发现若干例寨卡病例。

choices.text: Two million bees were infected with disease.
choices.zh: 两百万只蜜蜂感染了疾病。

choices.text: Zika virus had destroyed some bee farms.
choices.zh: 寨卡病毒摧毁了一些蜂场。

items.stem: What does the news report say about Flowertown Bee Farm?

choices.text: It apologized to its customers.
choices.zh: 它向顾客道歉。

choices.text: It was forced to kill its bees.
choices.zh: 它被迫杀死自己的蜜蜂。

choices.text: It lost a huge stock of bees.
choices.zh: 它损失了大量蜜蜂。

choices.text: It lost 2.5 million dollars.
choices.zh: 它损失了250万美元。

items.stem: What do we learn about the first flight of the Airlander 10?

choices.text: It stayed in the air for about two hours.
choices.zh: 它在空中停留了大约两个小时。

choices.text: It took off and landed on a football field.
choices.zh: 它在一个足球场上起飞和降落。

choices.text: It proved to be of high commercial value.
choices.zh: 它被证明具有很高的商业价值。

choices.text: It made a series of sharp turns in the sky.
choices.zh: 它在空中进行了一系列急转弯。

items.stem: What causes the US government to abandon the Airlander 10 as a spy aircraft?

choices.text: Engineering problems.
choices.zh: 工程问题。

choices.text: The air pollution it produced.
choices.zh: 它产生的空气污染。

choices.text: Inadequate funding.
choices.zh: 资金不足。

choices.text: The opposition from the military.
choices.zh: 来自军方的反对。

items.stem: What is the advantage of the Airlander 10 over huge jet planes?

choices.text: It uses the latest aviation technology.
choices.zh: 它使用了最新的航空技术。

choices.text: It flies faster than a commercial jet.
choices.zh: 它比商用喷气式飞机飞得更快。

choices.text: It is a safer means of transportation.
choices.zh: 它是一种更安全的交通工具。

choices.text: It is more environmentally friendly.
choices.zh: 它更加环保。

items.stem: What does the woman think of climate change?

choices.text: It seems a depressing topic.
choices.zh: 这似乎是个令人沮丧的话题。

choices.text: It sounds quite alarming.
choices.zh: 这听起来相当令人担忧。

choices.text: It has little impact on our daily life.
choices.zh: 它对我们的日常生活影响不大。

choices.text: It is getting more serious these days.
choices.zh: 近来它正变得越来越严重。

items.stem: Why do the speakers give up going to the Spanish Dance Festival tonight?

choices.text: The man doesn't understand Spanish.
choices.zh: 男士不懂西班牙语。

choices.text: The woman doesn't really like dancing.
choices.zh: 女士并不真正喜欢跳舞。

choices.text: They don't want something too noisy.
choices.zh: 他们不想要太吵闹的活动。

choices.text: They can't make it to the theatre in time.
choices.zh: 他们无法及时赶到剧院。

items.stem: What does the critic say about the comedy performed at the City Theatre?

choices.text: It would be more fun without Mr. Whitehead hosting.
choices.zh: 如果没有Whitehead先生主持会更有趣。

choices.text: It has too many acts to hold the audience's attention.
choices.zh: 它的节目太多,无法吸引观众的注意力。

choices.text: It is the most amusing show he has ever watched.
choices.zh: 这是他看过的最有趣的演出。

choices.text: It is a show inappropriate for a night of charity.
choices.zh: 这是一场不适合慈善之夜的演出。

items.stem: What does the woman decide to do tomorrow?

choices.text: Watch a comedy.
choices.zh: 看喜剧。

choices.text: Go and see the dance.
choices.zh: 去看舞蹈表演。

choices.text: Book the tickets online.
choices.zh: 在网上订票。

choices.text: See a film with the man.
choices.zh: 和男士一起看电影。

items.stem: Why does Catherine feel anxious?

choices.text: Most of her schoolmates are younger than she is.
choices.zh: 她的大多数同学都比她年轻。

choices.text: She simply has no idea what school to transfer to.
choices.zh: 她完全不知道该转到哪所学校。

choices.text: There are too many activities for her to cope with.
choices.zh: 有太多活动让她应接不暇。

choices.text: She worries she won't fit in as a transfer student.
choices.zh: 她担心自己作为转学生无法融入。

items.stem: What does Mr. Lee encourage Catherine to do?

choices.text: Seek advice from senior students.
choices.zh: 向高年级学生寻求建议。

choices.text: Pick up some meaningful hobbies.
choices.zh: 培养一些有意义的爱好。

choices.text: Participate in after-school activities.
choices.zh: 参加课外活动。

choices.text: Look into what the school offers.
choices.zh: 了解学校提供的资源。

items.stem: What does Mr. Lee promise to do for Catherine?

choices.text: Give her help whenever she needs it.
choices.zh: 在她需要时随时给予帮助。

choices.text: Accept her as a transfer student.
choices.zh: 接受她作为转学生。

choices.text: Find her accommodation on campus.
choices.zh: 为她在校园里找住处。

choices.text: Introduce her to her roommates.
choices.zh: 把她介绍给室友。

items.stem: What do we learn about Catherine's schoolmate Bree?

choices.text: She has interests similar to Mr. Lee's.
choices.zh: 她的兴趣与 Lee 老师相似。

choices.text: She has become friends with Catherine.
choices.zh: 她已经和 Catherine 成为朋友。

choices.text: She has chosen the major Catherine has.
choices.zh: 她选择了 Catherine 所选的专业。

choices.text: She has just transferred to the college.
choices.zh: 她刚刚转入这所大学。

items.stem: What is the researchers' purpose in carrying out the series of experiments with mice?

choices.text: To investigate how being overweight impacts on health.
choices.zh: 调查超重如何影响健康。

choices.text: To find out which physical drive is the most powerful.
choices.zh: 找出哪种生理驱动力最强。

choices.text: To discover what most mice like to eat.
choices.zh: 发现大多数小鼠喜欢吃什么。

choices.text: To determine what feelings mice have.
choices.zh: 确定小鼠有什么情感。

items.stem: In what circumstances, do mice venture into unsafe areas?

choices.text: When they are hungry.
choices.zh: 当它们饥饿时。

choices.text: When they are thirsty.
choices.zh: 当它们口渴时。

choices.text: When they smell food.
choices.zh: 当它们闻到食物时。

choices.text: When they want company.
choices.zh: 当它们想要同伴时。

items.stem: What is said about mice at the end of the passage?

choices.text: They search for food in groups.
choices.zh: 它们成群结队地寻找食物。

choices.text: They are overweight when food is plenty.
choices.zh: 当食物充足时它们会超重。

choices.text: They prefer to be with other mice.
choices.zh: 它们更喜欢与其他小鼠在一起。

choices.text: They enjoy the company of other animals.
choices.zh: 它们喜欢其他动物的陪伴。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the American highway system?

choices.text: Its construction started before World War I.
choices.zh: 其建设始于第一次世界大战之前。

choices.text: Its construction cost more than $40 billion.
choices.zh: 其建设耗资超过400亿美元。

choices.text: It is efficiently used for transport.
choices.zh: 它被高效地用于运输。

choices.text: It is one of the best in the world.
choices.zh: 它是世界上最好的公路系统之一。

items.stem: What was the original purpose of building a highway system?

choices.text: To improve transportation in the countryside.
choices.zh: 改善乡村地区的交通运输。

choices.text: To move troops quickly from place to place.
choices.zh: 快速地将部队从一地调动到另一地。

choices.text: To enable people to travel at a higher speed.
choices.zh: 使人们能够以更高的速度出行。

choices.text: To speed up the transportation of goods.
choices.zh: 加快货物运输的速度。

items.stem: When was the Interstate Highway System mostly completed?

choices.text: In the 1970s.
choices.zh: 在20世纪70年代。

choices.text: In the 1960s.
choices.zh: 在20世纪60年代。

choices.text: In the 1950s.
choices.zh: 在20世纪50年代。

choices.text: In the 1940s.
choices.zh: 在20世纪40年代。

items.stem: What is a major cause of road deaths among young Americans?

choices.text: Chatting while driving.
choices.zh: 开车时聊天。

choices.text: Messaging while driving.
choices.zh: 开车时发信息。

choices.text: Driving under age.
choices.zh: 未成年驾驶。

choices.text: Speeding on highways.
choices.zh: 在高速公路上超速。

items.stem: What is Smart Wheel?

choices.text: A gadget to hold a phone on the steering wheel.
choices.zh: 一种把手机固定在方向盘上的装置。

choices.text: A gadget to charge the phone in a car.
choices.zh: 一种在车内给手机充电的装置。

choices.text: A device to control the speed of a vehicle.
choices.zh: 一种控制车辆速度的装置。

choices.text: A device to ensure people drive with both hands.
choices.zh: 一种确保人们双手驾驶的装置。

items.stem: What happens if the driver has one hand on the wheel?

choices.text: The car keeps flashing its headlights.
choices.zh: 汽车会不停地闪烁前灯。

choices.text: The car slows down gradually to a halt.
choices.zh: 汽车会逐渐减速直至停止。

choices.text: They are alerted with a light and a sound.
choices.zh: 他们会收到灯光和声音警报。

choices.text: They get a warning on their smart phone.
choices.zh: 他们会在智能手机上收到警告。

items.stem: How do parents keep track of their teen's driving habits?

choices.text: Installing a camera.
choices.zh: 安装摄像头。

choices.text: Using a connected app.
choices.zh: 使用关联应用程序。

choices.text: Checking their emails.
choices.zh: 查看他们的电子邮件。

choices.text: Keeping a daily record
choices.zh: 保持每日记录。
